agentFiles.change: a new file: what agents do before they push

edits.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -4,15 +4,23 @@
 jobs:
   back:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
-      - run: cargo test --locked
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
+      - run: hushrun run --scope back test -- cargo test --locked
         working-directory: back
   cli:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     defaults:
       run:
         working-directory: cli
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
-      - run: cargo test --workspace --locked
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
+      - run: hushrun run --scope cli test -- cargo test --workspace --locked

--- /dev/null
+++ b/hushrun.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>
+
+# A check skips until its scope's files change, so each project's checks run for its
+# own changes, and what CI and its tools read.
+scopes:
+  back:
+    include:
+      - "back/**"
+      - "cli/crates/core/**"
+      - "cli/Cargo.toml"
+      - "*"
+      - ".github/workflows/**"
+    exclude:
+      - "*.md"
+      - "LICENSE*"
+      - "NOTICE*"
+  cli:
+    include:
+      - "cli/**"
+      - "*"
+      - ".github/workflows/**"
+    exclude:
+      - "*.md"
+      - "LICENSE*"
+      - "NOTICE*"

commands.after: hushrun run --scope back test -- cargo test --locked
hushrun run --scope cli test -- cargo test --workspace --locked

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
